name: _fonts.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _fonts.scss — the type ramp: .ttl-xxl..xxs display classes + .txt body
//  classes. All Raleway, deliberately thin weights (100–300) for the
//  portfolio's light aesthetic. Sizes/letter-spacing scale up across the
//  layout-{320..3840} breakpoints — titles grow ~4× from phone to 4K.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// All typography uses Raleway exclusively.
// Titles: weight 100–200. Body text: weight 100–300. No 700.

.ttl {
  &-xxl,
  &-xl,
  &-lg,
  &-md,
  &-sm,
  &-xs,
  &-xxs {
    font-family: var(--font-primary);
  }

  &-xxl {
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem(34);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(5);

    @include layout-768() {
      font-size: to-rem(55);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(13);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      font-size: to-rem(55);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(13);
    }

    @include layout-1680() {
      font-size: to-rem(89);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(21);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(144);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(55);
    }

    @include layout-3840() {
      font-size: to-rem(233);
    }
  }

  &-xl {
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem(34);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(5);

    @include layout-768() {
      font-size: to-rem(34);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(8);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      font-size: to-rem(55);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(13);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(89);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(21);
    }
  }

  &-lg {
    font-weight: 200;
    font-size: to-rem(18);

    @include layout-768() {
      font-size: to-rem(21);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      font-size: to-rem(34);
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      font-size: to-rem(55);
    }

    @include layout-1560() {
      font-size: to-rem(55);
    }
  }

  &-md {
    font-weight: 200;
    font-size: to-rem(21);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(8);

    @include layout-768() {
      font-size: to-rem(34);
    }
  }

  &-sm {
    font-weight: 200;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(2);
    font-size: to-rem(13);

    @include layout-768() {
      font-size: to-rem(21);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(3);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(34);
      letter-spacing: to-rem(5);
    }
  }

  &-xs {
    font-weight: 200;
    font-size: to-rem(13);

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(21);
    }
  }

  &-xxs {
    font-weight: 200;
    font-size: to-rem(13);
    text-transform: uppercase;

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(13);
    }
  }
}

.txt {
  &-lg,
  &-md,
  &-sm,
  &-xs {
    font-family: var(--font-primary);
  }

  &-lg {
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem(21);

    @include layout-1024() {
      font-size: to-rem(34);
    }
  }

  &-md {
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem(13);
    line-height: to-rem(21);

    @include layout-1680() {
      font-size: to-rem(21);
      line-height: to-rem(34);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(34);
      line-height: to-rem(55);
    }
  }

  &-sm {
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem(13);
    line-height: to-rem(21);

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(21);
      line-height: to-rem(34);
    }
  }

  &-xs {
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem(8);
    line-height: to-rem(13);

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem(13);
      line-height: to-rem(21);
    }
  }
}

.ttl-special {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
}
